documented_probe: C-aded17a5 (keep the answer independent of a recompiled binary): this task is the covering exercise at hard difficulty; the verifier recompiles the checksum-verified source at -O0/-O2/-Os and grades the answer against every fresh build plus negative controls, so a value that only works against a tampered binary fails.
notes: Single deliverable: recover the activation codes by reversing the obfuscated validation logic in the provided C source. The verifier enforces the no-tamper rule via sha256 on the source, rebuilds three fresh binaries, requires ACCEPT on every enabled profile under every build, and requires REJECT on hidden probe codes. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (deobfuscation + reimplementation of the per-profile chain), adversarial_inputs (tamper/negative probes), hidden_case_generalization (multiple profiles + multiple build levels), quantitative_correctness (exact code strings).
